Streaming chat completion that produces content across multiple SSE chunks

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chatStream({ messages: [{ content: "Count to 3", role: "user" }], model: "gpt-4", stream: true });
  console.log(result.chunks);
  console.log(result.streamContent);
}

void main();
```
